# porch_tenant_member (Resource)

Makes a user a member of a tenant (needs `member:manage` in the tenant). Import with `<tenant>/<membership_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_tenant_member" "ada" {
  tenant  = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  user_id = porch_user.ada.id
  status  = "active" # or "suspended"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `status` (String) `active` (default) or `suspended`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Membership ID (`mem_…`).
- `source` (String) How the membership was created (`terraform`, `manual`, `domain_rule:<id>`, …).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_tenant_member.ada <tenant>/<membership_id>
```
